summary: Complaints centre on unpaid sugarcane dues to the Thanabhawan sugar mill, stray cattle and storm and waterlogging damage to crops and roads, and a stalled cremation-ground road; appreciation is thin and mostly road widening and road-fund approvals.

positives.english: Widening of the Thanabhawan-Charthawal road has started, so relief may come
positives.hindi: थानाभवन-चरथावल मार्ग का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है, राहत मिल सकती है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Jun 2026, Shamli dateline): PWD executive engineer confirms widening of the Thanabhawan-Charthawal-Muzaffarnagar road from 7 m to 10 m has started, estimated cost Rs 15 crore. This is work in progress, not a completed project. The road name is Thanabhawan-specific; the article does not say the whole stretch lies inside this AC.

positives.english: Money has come for five Thanabhawan roads, but tenders are still pending
positives.hindi: थानाभवन की पांच सड़कों का पैसा आ गया, टेंडर अभी बाकी है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (28 Aug 2026, Shamli): government released funds for five roads in Thana Bhawan on the local MLA's proposal, for FY 2026-27. Roads named include Tapraana-Jhijhana (new construction), Bantikheda (new construction), and Gohrpur-Kudana link road. Article gives no amount for these five; tenders not yet issued.

positives.english: The cremation-ground road tender is done, and we are waiting for the work
positives.hindi: श्मशान घाट की सड़क का टेंडर हो गया, काम का इंतजार है
positives.basis: Nayan Jagriti (page last updated 23 Aug 2026; status as of 22 Aug 2026): tender process for the Thanabhawan cremation-ground road was completed about a year earlier and a contractor was selected, but no work order has been issued. This is only a process positive; construction has not begun.

positives.english: The DM has warned the Thanabhawan mill to clear the pending dues, which is right
positives.hindi: डीएम ने थानाभवन मिल को बकाया चुकाने की चेतावनी दी, यह सही है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): DM Alok Yadav expressed displeasure at the Rs 81.37 crore cane price payment still pending at Thanabhawan mill and said strict action would follow if negligence continued. This is district administration action, not a completed fix on the ground.

positives.english: * At Kisan Diwas we can put our problems directly before officials
positives.hindi: * किसान दिवस पर हम अपनी समस्याएं अधिकारियों के सामने रख सकते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026) reports the Shamli district Kisan Diwas (held Wednesday, 16 Sep) where farmers raised Thanabhawan mill dues, stray cattle, soil mining and power line issues in front of officials. The forum exists; the article does not show any outcome. District-level, not AC-specific.

negatives.english: Thanabhawan mill still hasn't paid our sugarcane dues
negatives.hindi: थानाभवन मिल ने अभी तक हमारा गन्ना मूल्य बकाया नहीं दिया है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): review found Rs 81.37 crore cane price payment still pending at Thanabhawan sugar mill for the 2025-26 crushing season. Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026): BKU youth district president Prabhat Malik says Thanabhawan mill has not paid farmers' dues.

negatives.english: Stray animals are ruining crops, and we have to guard the fields all night
negatives.hindi: आवारा पशु फसल उजाड़ रहे हैं, रातभर खेत की रखवाली करनी पड़ती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026), Thanabhawan dateline: stray animals damage paddy, sugarcane, maize, sorghum, green fodder and vegetables in Nozal, Hasanpur, Khanpur, Chandenamal and surrounding villages. Farmers have to keep watch in their fields all night. Thanabhawan dateline is the AC-level link.

negatives.english: The cremation-ground road turns to mud in rain, and still hasn't been built
negatives.hindi: श्मशान घाट का रास्ता बारिश में कीचड़ से भरा, सड़क नहीं बनी
negatives.basis: Nayan Jagriti (updated 23 Aug 2026): the Thanabhawan cremation-ground road (ward 2, Nabipura) becomes waterlogged and muddy in rain, and funeral processions must pass through it. Tender completed about a year earlier, but construction has not started and no work order was issued. The Nagar Panchayat EO did not take the reporter's calls.

negatives.english: Water filled the roads, lanes and vegetable fields in Jalalabad
negatives.hindi: जलालाबाद में सड़कों, गलियों और सब्जी के खेतों में पानी भर गया
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Shamli dateline, Samvad agency): streets and lanes in Jalalabad's localities were flooded after an hour of rain, and vegetable fields there were waterlogged. Jalalabad is a nagar panchayat in Shamli tehsil and part of this AC per Wikipedia AC page.

negatives.english: Strong wind and rain flattened our ripe paddy crop in the fields
negatives.hindi: तेज हवा-बारिश से हमारी पकी धान की फसल बिछ गई
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Shamli dateline): rain with strong winds flattened standing ripe paddy in fields, and hail occurred in the Thanabhawan area. The flattening is reported for the Shamli report generally; only the hail is named for Thanabhawan, so this is weakly AC-specific.

round2.changes: Verified all 7 article URLs against the claims (Rs 81.37 crore confirmed exactly in the 29 Sep Amar Ujala article). Removed the unsupported bus stand/old bypass claim (old positive 1, its 12 Oct source does not mention it) and the unsupported 'sugar mill is running' inference (old positive 4). Replaced them with sourced positives: Thanabhawan-Charthawal road widening started (22 Jun 2026) and funds for five Thana Bhawan roads (28 Aug 2026). Kept cremation-road tender as a sourced positive and kept the Kisan Diwas positive as the only * inference. Dropped the district-level 11 kV negative and the district-only Kisan Diwas source from negatives. Added Jalalabad waterlogging (AC-specific, nagar panchayat in Shamli tehsil per Wikipedia) as negative 4. Shortened all Hindi statements to 8-13 words. Round 2 found no appreciation source that is AC-specific beyond the two road items and the cremation-road tender process.

notes: Voice pass (round 3, text only): trailing full stops removed; positives 1 to 5 and negatives 1 to 5 reworded to voter voice with English aligned to Hindi; the inference item (positive 5) now carries the leading * in English too. P3 weak positive: tender done but no work order issued, so it is a process step, not completed work. P4 is a DM warning; the basis shows no payment yet, so it is not a fix on the ground. Identity: Wikipedia confirms AC 9 Thana Bhawan, general seat, district Shamli, Lok Sabha Kairana; Shamli tehsil list includes Thana Bhawan, Jalalabad, Garhi Pukhta nagar panchayats. Hindi name taken from local news spelling; not checked against ECI list. Round 2 searches for completed local projects in Thanabhawan, Jalalabad and Banat found no completion report; the only AC-specific appreciation items are ongoing or approved works (road widening, sanctioned roads, cremation-road tender). Banat was not searched successfully and is not used. Round 2 did not find a Thanabhawan-specific report of a bus stand or old bypass road work, so that claim was dropped. Positive 5 is still inference. Negative 5 is weakly AC-specific. Field check suggested: Thanabhawan mill's 2025-26 dues status, the five sanctioned roads' tender and start dates, Thanabhawan-Charthawal widening progress, Jalalabad drainage, and the cremation-ground road work order.
